ledger: 00:00-00:09: Exterior establishing shot of the diner shows a rectangular flat-roofed building with a central glass entrance door on the front facade flanked by large windows (booths visible on the left, counter and kitchen pass-through on the right) and a mostly solid concrete side wall on the right with only one small window near the rear.

00:10-00:18: Medium interior shot looking along the service counter toward the back wall shows a kitchen pass-through window in the center; to its left is a narrow wall section with a vertical poster next to a door/window frame, and to its right behind the counter is a wooden door and coffee station.

00:19-00:26: Wide interior shot looking toward the back wall shows the service counter and stools on the right, booths along a wall of windows on the left, a large window with a neon 'OPEN' sign to the left of the kitchen pass-through, and the customer entering the dining area from the doorway behind the counter on the back-right.

00:45-00:50: Reverse-angle shot from inside the kitchen looking out through the pass-through window shows the dining room counter on the left, booths and windows on the right, and the main glass entrance door (with an 'EXIT' sign above it and a glass-door beverage cooler to its left) at the far front end of the room.

00:51-00:59: Medium interior shot of the counter and pass-through window again shows the narrow wall with the vertical poster and side door/window frame immediately to the left of the kitchen opening.

01:18-01:26: Wide shot looking toward the back kitchen wall shows the waitress walking around the far end of the counter to the customer side and sitting on the stool to the left of the man (closer to the back kitchen wall than the man).

01:27-01:34: Reverse-angle shot looking toward the front wall of the diner (counter on the left, windows and booths on the right, beverage cooler visible in the far-left background) shows the man in the foreground and the waitress seated behind him closer to the front cooler wall.
01:41-01:49: Interior shots looking out through the side windows above the booths show the man walking outside past the window to a green box truck parked alongside the diner.

01:50-01:58: Wide shot looking toward the back wall shows the waitress standing up from the counter stool and walking around the counter into the right-hand service area while a second copy of the waitress simultaneously appears inside the kitchen pass-through window.

findings.entity: Customer traversal and back-right counter doorway
findings.invariant_violated: Traversal must be consistent with established floor plan
findings.description: The customer enters the diner by walking out from the back-right doorway behind the staff service counter next to the kitchen pass-through, rather than from the front entrance door (shown at the opposite end of the room in 00:45-00:50 and on the front facade in 00:00-00:09). Furthermore, the exterior shot (00:00-00:09) shows a solid exterior wall on the right side with no entrance door in that back-right location.

findings.entity: Back wall to the left of the kitchen pass-through
findings.invariant_violated: Consistent room layout and openings across camera angles
findings.description: In the medium shots of the back wall (00:10-00:18, 00:51-00:59, 01:35-01:36), the wall immediately to the left of the kitchen pass-through features a vertical poster next to a door/window frame at the edge of the room. In the wide shots of the same back wall (00:19-00:26, 00:36-00:44, 01:00-01:08, 01:18-01:26, 01:50-01:58), that doorway and poster disappear and are replaced by a wider wall section and a large storefront window with a neon 'OPEN' sign.

findings.entity: Counter seating arrangement relative to front and back walls
findings.description: In 01:18-01:26 (looking toward the back kitchen wall, counter on the right), the waitress sits on the stool to the left of the man, placing her closer to the back kitchen wall and the man closer to the front wall. In 01:27-01:34, the camera cuts to the reverse angle looking toward the front wall (counter on the left, windows/booths on the right, and the front-wall beverage cooler from 00:45 visible in the background), which geometrically requires the waitress to be in the foreground and the man in the background; instead, their relative positions along the counter are inverted, placing the waitress closer to the front cooler wall.

findings.entity: Kitchen pass-through window and waitress traversal
findings.invariant_violated: View through opening must match established space and occupancy
findings.description: As the waitress stands up from the customer stool and walks around the end of the counter into the right-side service area, a second copy of the same waitress simultaneously appears inside the kitchen through the pass-through window, resulting in two instances of the waitress occupying connected spaces at the same time.
